Name: Portfolio Command Center
Description: PSC Member's account-wide portfolio oversight. Editable/all only on the Portfolio Status Report (its creator) — the consolidated PPSR (with its Project Summaries child rows of approved-PSR health/cost figures) is this role's reporting surface. Project/Risk/Cost Entry/PSR/Issue/Action Item are ReadOnly for this role and are not carded directly (the page-driven grant would escalate them to Delete/InitiateItems even for Board flows per the gate's static check) — residual gap, see decisions.md.
